readme.note: 349 source products × 5 requested markets = 1,745 records
Global; North America; UK; France; Germany
Demonstration only. Every market duplication is hypothetical; publisher availability has NOT been confirmed.
ALL rows: MOCK DATA — NOT VALIDATED. Do not use for client quotations or firm forecasts.
KPI, price and volume each vary by a deterministic ±10–15% from their source or tactic-peer baseline.
Uses median available source-based values from the same tactic where possible; otherwise illustrative tactic defaults.
Exactly ONE primary KPI per record, in Media Inventory column M.
Group by column E (Tactic); show publisher C, format G, KPI M, expected result T, estimated cost U, currency R.
Use column I; 'Global' is a separate simulated market option, not a verified union of all territories.
Source row in column B points back to the prior 349-row media inventory; provenance columns Z–AC.
Not yet scored; do not mark a publisher preferred until THH sets and validates scoring rules.
170 original formats remain unclassified; classify before using them for live recommendations.
Grey source cells should be ignored if applicable; formatting-based exclusions not validated in this demo.
Prototype cost and outcome calculations are rough; CPL demo uses a one-lead unit, not a full budget forecast.
Source currency retained where present; otherwise previous demo USD fallback. No FX conversion applied.
THH to validate product availability, price units, KPIs, audience and market before going live.
Cost = (impressions / 1,000) × CPM rate. Use S (volume) and Q (rate); cost is U. Missing S becomes 5,000.
If primary KPI is CTR, clicks = impressions × CTR. Uses S × N; expected clicks in T. This is separate from CPM pricing.
Read Tactic Descriptions column B, matched to Media Inventory column E; show once at the top of each tactic group.
Media Inventory T and U are formulas; changing impressions, rate or CTR recalculates results. AF and AG document assumptions.
All values and market availability remain mock/not validated; no claim of confirmed publisher rates.
All categories mapped; inferred products are mock, not verified.
100 leads × CPL rate; all CPL rows use campaign package costs.
CPM impression delivery and CTR click delivery are separate; CPM rates above 1,000 corrected.
Mock priority: 1 highest, 5 lowest; approximately 10% per tactic are priority 1, with at least one per tactic.
Six independent Yes/No mock flags; approximately 50% Yes per audience. Same flags across all five markets.
Use selected audience flags to filter before ranking by AH ascending. Flags and priorities are simulated, not verified audience reach.
Media Inventory AO: show the specific product rationale alongside each recommendation. Use Tactic Descriptions B for the overall tactic summary.
AO is generated from demo format, audience flags and priority; not verified publisher evidence.
